Tuesday

Dear Diary... ah, damn, no, I can't do it like this.

Wednesday

Okay, once again. I decided to start making some notes as an exercise. My memory feels bad and all days seem to be the same. It is said that journaling makes you remember stuff better. I will try and see how this works out.

Thursday

Today I was just walking around Murricaville area. I think such long walks help me concentrate. I need to get to know the surroundings better.

Friday

The forest seems familiar somehow: the plants, the light, the scents. One thing surprised me though, and it was the sound of howling. Since when do we have wolves around here? 

Saturday 

Restless today. Did some small chores and repairs around the house. I can't help thinking that the town is too quiet. What is missing? The traffic, maybe? The daily chatter of neighbors? Barking of dogs?

Sunday

A dream about flying. Gaining speed. Exhilaration. I don't actually know whether I'm in an airplane or not. I'm flying right above the treeline, I feel I'm reaching my destination, but I don't slow down for landing, I just go faster, treetops are closer. I wake up with a twitch of my whole body.

Tuesday

Decided to drive around Murricaville for a bit. Not much going on. Neighbors greet each other with "Bless the President!". The postman delivers "One Truth" (what happened to other newspapers?). Everything looks the same. Nothing is happening. Everything is thoroughly, deeply, incredibly boring.

Should I drive further and see how it is in other places?

Wednesday

I dreamt about dogs tonight. Don't remember the details, but it wasn't a pleasant dream. Barking, growling. Why they were so agitated? I don't know.

Thursday

Literally nothing happened today. I'm so bored I don't even know what to write here.

Saturday

Okay, I'm leaving tomorrow. I have a full tank. I really, really need to see other places.
